snippet.title: The Loopler Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The Loopler launches September 11, 2026!

A roguelite deckbuilder about a slot car driving in mesmerizing loops. Pick cards, place gates, and collect charms. Settle into the loop as numbers go up and dopamine fills your brain. See how far you can go in the pursuit of infinity.

It's almost time to loop for real

==Wishlist The Loopler==
